decisions.titleEn: The Last of Us Part II
decisions.headline: 《最后生还者2》PC非官方多人模组Twelve Weeks上线
decisions.summary: 非官方多人模组Twelve Weeks已面向《最后生还者2》复刻版PC版推出；制作者Kellie称多数开发工作使用Claude Code完成，游戏内背景文本也使用了生成式AI。
decisions.verification: IGN报道了模组已经上线、适用版本及制作者披露的AI使用情况；未将Sony是否采取行动写作既成事实。
decisions.reason: 已打开的可信媒体正文给出明确模组身份、上线状态、适用平台与制作方式，信息增量完整。
decisions.timeNote: IGN页面时间2026-11-26 11:00 UTC，折算北京时间为19:00。

versionsAndTerms: The Last of Us Part II Remastered

decisions.headline: 《侠盗猎车手VI》开发者解释为何未加入电锯等武器
decisions.summary: Rockstar联席工作室负责人Rob Nelson称，电锯未成为可用武器并非资源限制，而是这种武器在当前画面精度及Jason与Lucia的角色语境下显得“太过火”；武士刀同样未作为可用武器加入。
decisions.verification: IGN明确转述Rob Nelson接受VGC采访时的具名说明；仅采用文章可识别的开发者发言。
decisions.reason: 具名开发负责人解释设计取舍，转述链与事实边界清楚。
decisions.timeNote: IGN页面时间2026-11-26 16:09 UTC，折算北京时间为11月27日00:09。

decisions.reason: 正文明确标注为作者个人观点专栏，主要基于游玩体验讨论服装与通缉系统互动，未提供足以独立成条的首次披露、调查或技术／产业分析增量。

entries.headline: The Last of Us Part II Remastered PC Mod Twelve Weeks Adds Unofficial Multiplayer
entries.summary: The unofficial Twelve Weeks multiplayer mod is now available for The Last of Us Part II Remastered on PC; creator Kellie says Claude Code handled most of the development and generative AI produced in-game lore text.
entries.verification: IGN reports the released mod, target version, and the creator's disclosed AI use; no Sony action is presented as a confirmed fact.
entries.timeNote: The page timestamp converts to 19:00 Beijing time on November 26.

entries.headline: Grand Theft Auto VI Developer Explains Why Chainsaws Are Not Usable Weapons
entries.summary: Rockstar co-studio head Rob Nelson says omitting chainsaws was not a resource constraint, but a fit issue at the game's visual fidelity and for Jason and Lucia; katanas are likewise not usable weapons.
entries.verification: IGN relays Nelson's identifiable comments from a VGC interview.
entries.timeNote: The page timestamp converts to 00:09 Beijing time on November 27.
